system_objective: Visual hierarchy and layout specification for automated LinkedIn creative generation

core_design_patterns.visual_concept: Literal juxtaposition of everyday problems with exaggerated or unexpected objects
examples_in_dataset: Elephant sitting on roof to show strength
Muscular flexed arms drawn onto house roofline
Gloved hand shielding miniature house from rain
Roof styled as an open weather umbrella
core_design_patterns.best_for: B2B hooks, service reliability, high-stakes decision making, insurance, and agency services

core_design_patterns.visual_concept: Isolated physical objects paired with witty handwritten or typography cues
examples_in_dataset: Retro telephone receiver with cartoon speech bubble
Green keyboard keycaps 'W' and 'E' spelling 'Who We Are'
Flashlight casting light across canvas to symbolize discovery
core_design_patterns.best_for: Agency culture, introductions, thought leadership hooks, and conversation starters

core_design_patterns.visual_concept: High-contrast textured background with a physical disruption element revealing the punchline
examples_in_dataset: Torn paper reveal contrasting bold headline with serif truth
core_design_patterns.best_for: Contrarian takes, myths vs facts, carousel title slides, and tactical frameworks

core_design_patterns.visual_concept: Dramatic dynamic crop of real operational work paired with high-clarity typography block
examples_in_dataset: Architectural angle of roof work with question hook and CTA badge
core_design_patterns.best_for: Case studies, direct lead gen, operational audits, and quotes

elements: Category tag or secondary trust badges (e.g., ISO, 'creative agency')
zone_1_header.rules: Keep secondary to prevent competing with focal anchor.

elements: Primary visual anchor (isolated 3D asset, surreal composition, or central object)
Shadowing & depth (soft directional drop shadow grounding object on studio plane)
Negative space (minimum 30% canvas area around subject)
zone_2_focal_hero.rules: Must communicate the core premise instantly at 0.5-second feed scroll speed.

font_hierarchy.primary_hook: Ultra-bold sans-serif or heavy display (32-48pt scale equivalent)
font_hierarchy.secondary_clarifier: Medium sans-serif or contrasting editorial serif/handwriting
font_hierarchy.text_highlighting: Targeted color shifts on critical trigger words

elements: Contact channels (phone, URL, carousel swipe hint)
zone_4_footer_and_cta.rules: Subtle, clear contact path; avoid visual clutter.

color_and_style_guidelines.backgrounds: Off-white, subtle paper grain, light radial studio vignette, or bold monochrome solid
color_and_style_guidelines.palette_strategy: 1 dominant neutral (70%), 1 brand anchor tone (20%), 1 punchy accent (10%)
color_and_style_guidelines.lighting: Soft directional studio lighting with natural ambient occlusion.

agent_execution_schema._note: The original export was cut off inside step_2_image_prompt. Everything in this block was written by Claude on 2026-11-02 to complete it, following the framework above. Replace it if you recover the original.
agent_execution_schema.step_1_intent: Determine image archetype (Metaphor, Pun, Reveal, Direct). Give one sentence on why it suits the post's pillar and reader.

step_2_image_prompt.archetype: One of: Surreal Metaphor Hook, Clever Object / Visual Pun, Curiosity Gap / Editorial Reveal, Direct Service & Social Proof
step_2_image_prompt.subject: String. A single hero subject with a clear material, scale and action, e.g. 'a miniature concrete podium deck sheltered under an open yellow umbrella'. One subject only.
step_2_image_prompt.setting: String. Studio plane, texture or backdrop from color_and_style_guidelines.backgrounds. Commercial or industrial cues only.

composition.camera: String. Angle and lens feel, e.g. 'eye level, 50mm, shallow depth of field'
composition.negative_space: At least 30 percent of the canvas around the subject

style.render: 3D studio render | flat illustration | paper cut-out | annotated diagram
style.lighting: Soft directional studio lighting with natural ambient occlusion
style.shadow: Soft directional drop shadow grounding the object on the studio plane
style.texture: Optional: subtle paper grain or matte plastic. No photoreal fake site photos.

palette.accent: Hex or name, about 10 percent, used on the key trigger word and CTA

text_overlay.headline: String. Sentence case, no em dashes, ideally 8 words or fewer. Taken from the approved draft hook.
text_overlay.highlight_word: The one word in the headline that takes the accent colour
text_overlay.clarifier: Optional String. One short line in a contrasting editorial serif or handwriting.
text_overlay.cta_label: String. Matches the draft's single CTA: Request a site survey | Download the checklist | Book a call
text_overlay.demo_figure_tag: Include '[DEMO FIGURE]' if any placeholder figure appears, otherwise null

header_elements.brand_mark: PLACEHOLDER: 'Acme logo here'. Never invent a logo.
header_elements.category_tag: Optional plain label such as 'Waterproofing'. No ISO or certification badges.
header_elements.contact: PLACEHOLDER only. Never invent a phone number or URL.

avoid: fake photographs of real sites or projects
invented logos, certifications, client names or contact details
garbled or extra text beyond headline, clarifier and CTA
em dashes in any rendered text

agent_execution_schema.step_3_assemble_prompt: Join subject, setting, composition, style, palette and text_overlay into one natural-language prompt for the image tool. Keep the structured JSON alongside it.
step_4_guardrail_check: Archetype fits the pillar and reader
Headline matches the approved draft hook
Exactly one CTA, matching the draft
No invented logos, badges, photos, figures or contact details
Any placeholder figure is tagged [DEMO FIGURE]
Text is sentence case with UK spelling and no em dashes

step_5_output.save_to: Next to the draft in content/drafts/, or in a Visual section of the draft
